verdicts.reason: A sits roughly centred down the canvas, but the bottle medallion is small for a story format. A pale decorative circle floats alone in the top-left corner, and the right-aligned NEW and Try It pills don't line up with the left-aligned headline and bottle, so the layout looks split down the middle. B crams everything into the top 60% and leaves about 300px of dead orange at the bottom. Its bottle cap almost touches the top edge, and the decorative circle crowds the medallion, plus it has the same ragged left/right alignment.
